ModMetaData.name: Convergence: Qi-Tech
ModMetaData.author: Prospero1088
ModMetaData.description:
Qi-Tech for Convergence: Era of Cultivation (v0.1), only for those who play with technology.
A qi converter that joins the qi network with the vanilla power grid (qi to electricity or electricity to qi, by mode), a Qi-Tech exoskeleton with a qi core and high celestial dissonance, and a stabilization chamber that lowers the celestial dissonance of mechanical implants for a week. Requires industrial research; the base mod never does.
Requires Convergence: Era of Cultivation and Convergence: Formations.
